Class SecurityFundamental

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.entities.SecurityFundamental
@Entity public class SecurityFundamental extends Object
One fundamental base value of a direct equity as one source delivered it, with its basis and the outcome of its checks. The weekly load task is the only writer: it replaces the rows of every source that answered, records the source checks in sourceCheck and lets the selection grade every row in state. A watchlist indicator column binds an expression variable only from the row graded CONFIRMED, CHECKED or SINGLE.

The table is derived data rebuilt by the load task, so it has no export definition, and it is not user-writable, so it has no limit key. It is not a BaseID entity, which keeps it out of the derived daily CUD limits.
